one_liner: Zoho Cliq has a broad REST API (v2/v3) with self-serve OAuth 2.0 via Zoho API Console, a free plan with API support, and an official vendor-hosted MCP server.
auth_notes: REST API uses OAuth 2.0 authorization code flow with client registered in Zoho API Console; multi-datacenter (accounts.zoho.{dc}). Integration-component (bot/webhook) API tokens also exist as request parameters.
access_notes: Free plan lists API support: Yes. OAuth client registration in the API console is self-serve. Rate limits per user per minute apply (e.g. 15/min for Get Messages).
blocker_notes: Minor: per-datacenter handling and tight per-user rate limits.
